title: ores-api-docs RPC receipt frame
description: Transport-neutral reply to a call. HTTP status is duplicated in `status` so TCP, WebSocket, and NATS callers share the same result mapping. Application response headers and trailers are carried explicitly so HTTP/gRPC-style metadata survives every transport. Success and error receipts are disjoint by `ok`; status remains optional for compatibility but is state-bounded when present. Canonical operation identity uses a stable dotted rpc_key; legacy identifier keys remain admitted during migration.

key.description: Canonical stable dotted rpc_key, with legacy portable identifiers admitted during migration.

status.description: Optional HTTP-shaped status. Success permits 200-399; failure permits 400-599.

headers.description: Application response headers after transport/runtime-owned metadata has been separated.

trailers.description: Application response trailers. May be present on both success and failure receipts.
